hook_text: Every rand a business touches goes on the same six-stop journey. Miss one stop and the books fall apart.
clip_script: A customer pays a repair shop to fix her fridge. Stop one: the transaction. Stop two: the shop writes a receipt and keeps the copy, the source document. Stop three: the receipt goes into the cash receipts journal, the diary, in date order. Stop four: at month-end the columns are added up and the totals are posted into the ledger, one folder per item: bank, current income, capital, loan. Stop five: every folder's balance goes on one page, the trial balance, and left must equal right. Stop six: the report cards, the income statement and the balance sheet. Transaction, source document, journal, ledger, trial balance, financial statements. T, S, J, L, T, F. And then? The road starts again next month.
visual_style: A whiteboard road with six signposts, a single rand coin rolling from a fridge to a receipt, a journal page, a row of folders, a balanced page and two report cards.
mood: Journey-like and orderly, with a satisfying loop at the end.
pacing: One beat per stop, a quick recap of the six letters, a loop back to the start.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and follow a month of transactions down the road.
